0: Entrance shaft. Air still tastes of surface.
Thin seam of chalk in the wall. No ore, but promising.
Old torch stub in the stone. Someone dug here before.
Rootlets pushing through the ceiling. Still near the surface.
Pebbles underfoot. Smooth, water-worn. Ancient stream bed.
Low ceiling. Had to press close to the wall.
Patch of moss on the north face. Moisture in the rock.
Faint dripping somewhere ahead. Getting deeper.
Gravel chute. Held still until it settled.
Soil giving way to true stone. The real work starts here.
1: Aquifer seeping through a crack. Floor slick with it.
Gallery opens up. Ceiling lost in the dark above.
Calcite formations on the wall. Smoother than the stone beside them.
Smell of sulfur. Distant, but real.
Bones of something in a side passage. Old. Very old.
Fossil half-emerged from the limestone. Strange fish-shape.
Dripstone columns ahead, floor to ceiling. Navigated through carefully.
Sound of water under the floor. A buried river.
The rock changed color here. Banded layers. Thousands of years of quiet.
Wind from somewhere. No way to know which direction.
2: Absolute darkness below the ledge. Dropped a stone. Did not hear it land.
The walls are warm here. Not from the stone.
Ancient city brickwork in the distance. Did not go closer.
Magma block underfoot. Backed off and found another way.
Ceiling dripping slowly, one drop every few seconds. Counted them.
No wind. No sound. The rock absorbs everything.
Sculk patches on the floor. Stepped around each one.
Vein of deepslate running floor-to-ceiling. Millions of years compressed into a seam.
Glow of magma through a crack in the wall. Held paw to it. Warm.
Passage narrowed to nothing. Backtracked. Found another way down.
The dark here drinks sound. Drinks light. Drinks the paws walking through it.
Found a pickhead in the gravel. Iron, no handle, no name. Someone's last day's work.
A vein of copper ran through the wall like a river drawn on a map nobody made.
The stone here remembers more than I do. It has had longer.
Heard water moving under the floor. A river that has never seen the sky.
A handprint set in the calcite. Not mine. Older than mine by years I cannot count.
Deepslate so dark the torchlight grew tired and bent away.
Walked past a chamber I did not enter. Some doors are better left closed.
Magma far below, slow as a breath held too long. Not in any hurry.

light: Passage looped. Spent time finding north again.
Wrong tunnel for a while. Doubled back. Lost time.
Sound of many feet. Stayed still until it passed.
Groaning in the walls. Zombie trapped in the stone somewhere.
Something moved in the chamber below. Did not go down.
Loose pebble down the wrong slope. Slid further than I meant to.
Lost the torch. Found it again, eventually.
Dead end where the map said tunnel. Re-drew the map in my head.
Stepped on a stone that gave. The stone forgave it.
Bat colony overhead. Walked very softly. Mostly avoided being a roost.
moderate: Ceiling cracked. Held still. It held.
Gravel pour from above. Moved before it filled the corridor.
Water flooded the lower corridor fast. Climbed out.
Deep water ahead, no bottom. Found another way around.
Clicking in the dark behind me. Picked up the pace.
Breath in the dark that wasn't mine. Not going back that way.
Heat rising through the floor. Magma below. Found a way around it.
Pickaxe head got stuck. Worked it out. Took longer than the seam would have.
Found a passage that breathed. Did not stay long.
Squeezed through a crack that thought I was smaller. I was smaller, just barely.
Loose stone gave way under the paw. Caught myself on a ledge that had not been there a moment before.
Crystal underfoot, sharp. The paw will remember it.
severe: Lava pocket opened up mid-swing. Retreated fast. Singed.
Cave-in above. Buried the passage. Had to dig back out.
Support pillar gone. The whole section leaned. Left quickly.
Aquifer burst through the wall. Cold and sudden. Lost the passage.
Something in the dark that wasn't afraid. Moved fast.
Whole gallery came down. Got under a ledge. The ledge held. The rest did not.
Lava came through the wall. The wall had not warned me about itself.
Stepped through a floor that was a ceiling. The fall was not the longest part.
A sound below that the rock did not want to translate.
The pickaxe broke against something the pickaxe was not meant for.

no_tool: Nothing left to swing. Going back to the bed.
No tool. No work. Back to the bed.
precious_break: Pickaxe too precious to break. Heading back.
The enchanted pickaxe deserves better than this. Heading home.
Will not let this pickaxe end here. Coming back with it whole.
Worth too much to lose. Setting the work down. Coming home.
Could not bring myself to spend the last of it. Going home with it intact.
broken: The head came off the haft. The haft came off the paw.
Iron split along an old fracture. Gone.
Worked it past its limit. The limit won.
last_gone: Bag holds no more stone-work. Going home.
End of the iron. End of the work. Coming home.
Last of the pickaxes spent. Walking back.
Nothing left to dig with. Turning toward the bed.
switched_spare: Set down the worn one. Picked up the next.
Spare in the bag. Used it.
Old pickaxe to the side. New pickaxe in paw.
Picked up the second pickaxe. Carried on.
nearly_done: Iron thin on the haft. Going home before it goes.
Last few swings left in it. Saving them for the way.
The pickaxe is tired. So am I. Both heading home.
Almost spent. Coming back before it finishes.
